_comment: GolfMe Review Gate policy. Development tooling only; never imported by src/. Real OpenAI calls enabled 2026-09-29 (approved by Micky, P0). The API key lives in ~/.golfme-review/openai.key, never in the repo.

pricing._comment: USD per 1M tokens for gpt-6-sol, standard tier, from developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing on 2026-09-29 (cached-input discount ignored, so estimates run high). Prompts over 272K input tokens cost more, but payloads are capped far below that. null = cost unknown, so real calls are refused.

_publishedContactEmailSha256: SHA-256 of lowercased non-personal addresses allowed to appear in reviewed code: (1) the contact address published on golfme.app/privacy and /terms; (2) Resend's shared sender address used by the waitlist and report alert triggers (approved by Micky 2026-09-30). Matches are replaced with a placeholder and do not block the review; the addresses are never sent. Only hashes are stored here. Every other email/PII still blocks.
